newsitem.title: USA: U.S. power output rises 4.0 pct vs. year ago - EEI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. power output rises 4.0 pct vs. year ago - EEI.

text.p: Electricity deliveries in the continental U.S. totaled 61,355 gigawatt hours (GWh) for the week ended September 28, up four percent from the same period in 1995, the Edison Electric Institute (EEI) said.
The amount of power supplied to the South Central rose the most from a year ago, up 10.1 percent to 8,868 GWh, with some air conditioning demand in the region during the week.
Year-to-date domestic power production totaled about 2.51 million GWh, up 2.3 percent from the same period in 1995, EEI said.
